note: PLACEHOLDER SET for testing the app. Replace with the Talisman Paris 50 dataset. Notes are draft copy, not Talisman's editorial voice.

places.name: Musée Rodin
places.note: Sculpture set loose in a garden. Go for the rose beds and the light on bronze late in the day.

places.name: Place des Vosges
places.note: A perfect square of brick and stone. Walk the arcades once, slowly, end to end.

places.name: Jardin du Luxembourg
places.address: Rue de Médicis / Rue de Vaugirard, 75006
places.note: Pull a green chair to the Medici fountain and stay longer than you planned.

places.name: Palais de Tokyo
places.note: Raw concrete halls for the contemporary. The terrace looks straight at the river.

places.name: Shakespeare and Company
places.note: Climb to the reading room upstairs. Notre-Dame sits across the water.

places.name: Musée de l'Orangerie
places.note: Two oval rooms built around Monet's water lilies. Daylight comes from above.

places.name: Bourse de Commerce
places.note: Tadao Ando's concrete cylinder set inside an 18th-century rotunda. Walk the upper ring.

places.name: Fondation Louis Vuitton
places.note: Gehry's glass sails at the edge of the Bois. The roof terraces are the building.

places.name: Maison La Roche
places.note: Early Le Corbusier. The ramp in the gallery is a lesson in promenade.

places.name: Institut du monde arabe
places.note: Nouvel's south facade of mechanical apertures. Free rooftop over the Seine.

places.name: Parc des Buttes-Chaumont
places.note: A former quarry turned picturesque. Climb to the temple on the cliff.

places.name: Coulée verte René-Dumont
places.note: An elevated rail line planted as a walk. Start near Bastille and head east.

places.name: Musée Bourdelle
places.note: The sculptor's studios, kept close to how he left them. Quiet, and rarely full.
